title: Trump thanks Giants' Jaxson Dart in Truth Social post: 'YOU ARE A WINNER'

sources.title: Trump thanks Giants' Jaxson Dart in Truth Social post: 'YOU ARE A WINNER'
sources.description: The New York Giants may want to move forward as a team after Jaxson Dart's introduction of Donald Trump, but the president isn't yet willing to do so.
